title: Prior Authorization Extension Rules
content:
## Provider Manual section: extending an approval

**Rule.** Where the class allows extensions, a Prairie Ridge Health Plan Prior Authorization approval may be extended up to the class's most extensions per authorization, each extension adding at most the class's extension allotment of units and moving the end date forward by the class's extension days. The extensions already granted are counted as the grant entries on the authorization marked as granted by extension. An extension request is accepted as an extension only when it is received no later than the class's late grace days after the authorization's end date. The grace days are counted in calendar days from the day after the end date, and a request on the last grace day still qualifies. An extension is requested only on an authorization in approved or expired status. A request received later, or beyond the extension count, is handled as a new request with its own review.

The class settings this rule reads — whether extensions are allowed, the most extensions, the extension allotment, the extension days, the late grace days and the concurrent review interval — are the class's extension allowances.

## Conditions, restated

| Condition | Evidence | Where it is not met |
|---|---|---|
| The class allows extensions | the class of the authorization | — |
| Fewer extensions granted than the class's most extensions | grant entries marked as granted by extension on the authorization | handled as a new request with its own review |
| Received no later than the late grace days after the end date | the authorization's end date on the plan's record; calendar days counted from the day after the end date; the last grace day qualifies | handled as a new request with its own review |
| The authorization is approved or expired | the authorization's status on the plan's record | not requested as an extension |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Class with 3 late grace days, end date on the 10th of a month: grace day 1 is the 11th and grace day 3 is the 13th. A request received on the 13th is accepted as an extension; a request received on the 14th is handled as a new request.
- Class with 0 late grace days, end date on the 10th: a request received on the 10th is accepted as an extension; a request received on the 11th is handled as a new request.
- Class allowing 2 extensions where 2 grant entries marked as granted by extension already stand on the authorization: a further request is handled as a new request.
